stations.title: Ossian
stations.say: Nobody can read my chalk nines.

stations.title: Chalk board
stations.text: Times and seats wherever they fit

captions: The slip at Lanternquay. Ossian wants the chalk departure board printed instead.
On the chalk board the Linnet's time and seats are a smudge nobody can read.
You line up each row, build the whole board, and read the references callers give.
Now the Linnet sits in its own row, its time and seats in straight columns.
The board at the slip reads at a glance, and so does every ticket reference.
